## Why this plugin exists

DSH shows one conversation at a time. When you juggle several sessions — a long
agent run, a quick q

uestion, a code review — you keep clicking back and forth in
the sidebar. Desktop mode lets you keep

them all on screen at once, arrange them
side by side, and park the rest in a taskbar.

## Features
| Feature | What it does |
| **Desktop mode switch** | Sits directly above Settings. Off by default; the choice persists in thi

s browser. Turning it off returns to the normal conversation on the focused window's session. |
| **
Sessions as windows** | Clicking a session in the sidebar opens it as a window. A session can only h
ave one window — clicking it again restores and focuses the existing one. Every window shows the **s
ame conversation UI as the main chat** — header, view tabs, transcript, composer, and anything other

plugins add (for example `dsh-rewind-plugin`'s rewind button under your messages). |
| **Window tit
les** | Every title bar reads `workspace | session` (for example `acme-web | Fix flaky checkout test
`), with the workspace name in a quieter colour. Ungrouped sessions show just the session title. The

full label is also the window's tooltip and accessible name. |
| **Find it in the sidebar** | Hover
ing a window highlights its session and its workspace in the sidebar. If that workspace is collapsed
, it opens while you hover and closes again when you move away (unless you clicked in the sidebar me
anwhile). Turn this off in **Plugins → dsh-desktop-ui → Highlight the sidebar on hover**; the choice

is saved with the layout. |
| **Taskbar tooltips** | Hovering (or keyboard-focusing) a taskbar butt

on shows `workspace | session`, plus "minimized" or "popped out" when it applies. |
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility and limitations
**Requires DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`.** Tested on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 with Node 24.
This is an **internal integration**, not a stable public DSH API. It plugs into:
| Seam | Use |
| `main` keyed slot, key `dsh-desktop-ui` | the desktop canvas and taskbar, selected with `ctx.layou

t.selectPanel` |
| `main.conversation` entry | each window renders the stock conversation entry's ow
n component with its own render rights, captured when DSH first renders it, so every plugin contribu
tion appears inside windows too (falls back to the `conversation.content` factory if unavailable) |
| `dsh-desktop-ui.window` (session-scoped child slot) | one window body per session, under that sess

ion's scope |
| `plugins.bundle.config` (key `dsh-desktop-ui`) | the plugin's settings on its own Pl

ugins page (the hover opt-out) |
| `sidebar.footer.action` (order −100) | the Desktop mode switch, s

orted first; the footer row is stacked vertically while it is present |
| `conversation.header.leadi

ng` (popout pages only) | the **Pop back in** button in a popped-out window's header |
| `BroadcastC
hannel('dsh-desktop-ui.v1')` | same-origin messages between the canvas and popout windows (`popped`,

`pop-in-request`, `pop-in`, `closed`); session ids only |
| `configForms` (`dsh-desktop-ui` namespa

ce) | Host-backed `layout` field (volatile plugin config) for restart-proof restore |
| `ctx.session
s.retain(id, { source: 'desktopWindow' })` | each window owns an independent session reference, rele

ased on close |
| `ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession` / `startSession` | keeps the sidebar selection in sy
nc and creates new sessions |

While Desktop mode is on, navigation that would normally reveal the conversation
(sidebar clicks, Ne

w Session, shortcuts) is captured: the session opens as a
window and the desktop stays visible.
Known limitations:

- Later DSH versions may change these internal seams; the plugin may need an update.
- The right sid

ebar (files, terminal, browser) still belongs to the main session, not to individual windows.
- Wind

ow positions are stored per browser, not per account or device.
[该节后续省略]
## Build and test
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- Editable client source is `client/index.mjs`. `scripts/build.mjs` writes `lib/client.js`, a lazy m
odule that uses the GUI's own React (React is not bundled). Run `npm run build` and commit `lib/clie

nt.js` after editing the source; a unit test fails if it is stale.
- `cordis.patch.yml` registers th

e package.
- `index.mjs` declares the volatile `layout` Config field using the running harness's own

schemastery; it has no other host behaviour.
- Client inject list: `dsh-api-session-controller`, `d
sh-client-ui-layout`, `dsh-client-ui-session`, `dsh-client-ui-sidebar`, `dsh-client-ui-conversation`

, `dsh-client-ui-chat`, `dsh-client-ui-workspace`, `dsh-client-ui-settings`.
- `test/state.test.mjs`
covers the window manager (open/focus/minimize/maximize/close, one window per session, move never r
esizes, snapping, linked borders, appearance and wallpaper validation, layouts, show desktop, prunin
g, state sanitising, text size), Host persistence (restore, seeding, debounced and serialized writes
, malformed values, early local changes), popout detection and URLs, footer ordering, runtime identi

ties, and bundle freshness.
- `scripts/e2e-gui.mjs` is a dependency-free headless Chrome/CDP test ag
ainst a real, isolated DSH instance. See LOCAL-SETUP.md.
